caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a fitted lid, both of which appear to be crafted from a ceramic or earthenware material. The container is primarily a yellowish-green color, with brownish-red decorative patterns covering its surface. The body of the container is adorned with a symmetrical floral motif, including a central flower with radiating petals and surrounded by large, curved leaf shapes. The lid has a small knob on top and also features similar brownish-red ornamental patterns. The container rests on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Pa. German Covered Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
